description.value: Жрица обладает абсолютным иммунитетом к урону ядом, состоянию отравлен и болезням.
Рукопашная атака оружием: +4 к попаданию, досягаемость 5 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 6 (1к8 + 2) дробящего урона плюс 7 (2к6) урона ядом.

Заклинатель 7-го уровня, базовая характеристика — Мудрость (ячейки по данным игры).

  • 1-й уровень (4 ячеек): Лечение ран [Cure Wounds]
  • 2-й уровень (3 ячеек): Паралич гуманоида [Hold Person], Тишина [Silence]
  • 3-й уровень (1 ячеек): Благословение [Bless]
  • 4-й уровень (1 ячеек): Декламация [Recitation]

Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be &Reference[paralyzed] for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

materials.value: A small, straight piece of iron

effects.name: Hold Person
effects.description: The target is Paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

description.value:
A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

effects.name: Bless
effects.description: Whenever you make an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

description.value: For the Duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are Deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a Spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.

Вы декламируете священные молитвы своего божества. Все союзники в радиусе 30 футов от вас получают бонус +2 к броскам атак и спасброскам. Все враги в этой же области совершают броски атак и спасброски со штрафом -2. Аура перемещается вместе с вами.

Союзники в радиусе 30 футов получают +2 к броскам атак и спасброскам, а враги получают -2 к ним.

На более высоких уровнях. При сотворении этого заклинания с использованием ячейки 5-го уровня или выше вы получаете 10 временных хитов за каждый уровень ячейки выше 4-го.

description.value: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather. This armor offers modest protection to the wearer's upper body and allows the sound of the rings rubbing against one another to be muffled by outer layers.
A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
A heavy iron ball attached to a stout wooden shaft with a heavy chain, allowing it to deal devastating damage at the end of wide, sweeping swings.
